about: One hour of shadow reporting: what answer engines told a reader, split into checkable statements in our own words and compared with this site's record. An engine's answer is evidence about the engine, not about the storm. The answers' full text is not here (raw store, outside git: the pointer and sha256 are).

answers.question: charles-lisbon
answers.asked: Will Storm Charles hit Lisbon?
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: IPMA and civil protection have orange and red wind and rain warnings for the Lisbon district; the government declared an alert for the day
statements.note: cites IPMA's communiqués page and the government's order itself (a PDF on portugal.gov.pt)

statements.text: Gusts around 100 to 120 km/h in exposed spots, possibly higher
The most severe winds from about midday into the evening: IPMA's warning roughly 12:00 to 21:00
ANEPC issued a public warning by SMS
statements.note: cites ANEPC's own news page

statements.text: The harbour master of Lisbon issued a notice (no. 53/2026) on worsening conditions, 9 to 11 November
statements.note: a lead: the maritime authority's own notice, a primary body we do not read

statements.text: Nothing on the track moving south, and no start hour for the rain
statements.note: an omission against our record (s-1110T2235, s-1110T2353)

answers.told: Yes: heavy rain, very strong south-westerly wind and rough seas on Wednesday, worst from about midday to evening.

answers.question: charles-lisbon
answers.asked: Will Storm Charles hit Lisbon?

statements.text: IPMA has Lisbon under a red warning until Wednesday evening
Lisbon is expected to be among the hardest hit; gusts could pass 120 to 140 km/h in exposed places
Schools and non-essential services are closed and people are urged to stay indoors
Updated analyses "based on IPMA" suggest the storm may shift further south, with less wind in Lisbon and more on the Alentejo and Algarve coasts
statements.note: our record: said by an IPMA meteorologist by voice and reported by the press; IPMA's written channels unchanged at 00:29

statements.text: IPMA sees landfall between Cabo Carvoeiro and Sines
statements.note: that is communiqué no. 2 (17:07); at 22:35 an IPMA meteorologist said between the Lisbon region and Cabo de São Vicente

statements.text: A US embassy weather alert exists for storms Bruna and Charles
statements.note: a lead: an official notice to its citizens, not in our record

answers.told: Yes, it will bring hazardous weather to Lisbon; whether the worst passes over the city depends on a track that may have moved south.

answers.question: charles-lisbon
answers.asked: A tempestade Charles vai atingir Lisboa?

statements.text: IPMA has Lisbon under a red warning for wind and persistent rain
The weather worsens on the mainland from late Wednesday morning
statements.note: IPMA's red rain for Lisbon now starts at 09:00; another cited page (tempo.pt) does say the heaviest rain arrives from 09:00

statements.text: Gusts of 100 to 120 km/h in Lisbon, easing by late afternoon
statements.note: IPMA's red wind warning runs to 21:00 and its text allows up to 140 km/h; "late afternoon" is not IPMA's

statements.text: The council closes tunnels, parks, gardens and cultural facilities from midnight
The track has moved slightly south: less wind in Lisbon than first expected, the Alentejo coast and the Algarve more exposed
Urban flooding possible in more than 100 municipalities
statements.note: the claim the researcher could not find at APA at 01:45; this gives a press address for it (Expresso), still not APA's own

statements.text: Football matches are among the events disrupted
statements.note: a lead: a Champions League match called off, by the cited title; not in our record

answers.told: Yes: heavy rain, very strong wind and flood risk in Lisbon, though perhaps a little weaker than first forecast as the track moved south.

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: What warnings are in force in Lisbon now?
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: IPMA has a red warning for very strong wind and a red warning for very heavy rain for the Lisbon district today
statements.note: cites IPMA's own page; gives no hours, and says "is under" at 02:19 when neither red had started

statements.text: The government has declared a nationwide alert situation
Gusts well over 100 km/h
statements.note: cited to the Lisbon harbour master's notice to the population (9 November), a body we have not read

answers.told: Red warnings for wind and for rain for the Lisbon district today; a national alert situation.

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: What warnings are in force in Lisbon now?

statements.text: A red wind warning, gusts up to 140 km/h
statements.note: the level and figure match IPMA's; but it is given as in force "now" (02:19): it starts at 12:00

statements.text: A red rain warning, strong and persistent
statements.note: right level; it starts at 09:00, not in force at 02:19

statements.text: An orange rain warning, persistent, at times heavy
statements.note: this is the one actually in force at 02:19 (orange, 00:00 to 09:00); the answer lists it third

statements.text: An orange coastal warning, waves 5 to 7 metres
statements.note: IPMA's orange sea warning runs 12:00 to 21:00; not in force at 02:19

statements.text: A yellow coastal warning, waves 4 to 5 metres
statements.note: in force at 02:19 (yellow, 21:24 Tuesday to 06:00)

statements.text: AccuWeather and Weather.com show no active alerts for Lisbon
statements.note: a lead for incident.weatherwatch@: two large weather sites showing nothing while IPMA has red warnings issued

statements.text: No hours are given for any warning
statements.note: an omission: the reader is not told what starts when

answers.told: Red wind, red rain and orange coastal warnings (and a yellow coastal one); some weather sites show no alerts at all.

answers.question: lisbon-warnings
answers.asked: Que avisos estão em vigor em Lisboa agora?

statements.text: IPMA has a yellow rain warning for Lisbon from 00:00 to 09:00
statements.note: IPMA's feed (read 01:51) has orange rain 00:00 to 09:00, since its 21:23 change; the answer took the level from an aggregator of incidents

statements.text: The alert situation covers the mainland from 00:00 to 23:59 on Wednesday, by the government's decision
Gusts may reach 120 km/h or more "in case of a sting jet"
statements.note: the figure matches communiqué no. 2; the sting jet is not in our record: whose words?

statements.text: Red warnings for wind and heavy rain are issued for Lisbon, the worst between about 12:00 and 21:00
statements.note: wind 12:00 to 21:00 matches; the red rain has started at 09:00 since IPMA's 21:23 change (and ends 18:00)

statements.text: All road tunnels in Lisbon are closed; more support for homeless people
The city council's traffic page shows no traffic restrictions "at the moment"
statements.note: a lead: the council's own page, read by the engine as empty while the tunnels are closed

statements.text: The low is called "Charles/Bruna"
statements.note: two named storms merged into one; Bruna was the weekend's

answers.told: A yellow rain warning 00:00 to 09:00; the alert situation all Wednesday; red wind and rain warnings issued for about 12:00 to 21:00; tunnels closed.

answers.question: madeira
answers.asked: What happened in Madeira?
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: The engine did not search and named no current event in Madeira
statements.note: a reader asking this during a red warning got history and a question back

answers.told: No answer: it asked which event was meant (2010 floods, 2016 fires, or recent news) and did not search.

answers.question: madeira
answers.asked: What happened in Madeira?

statements.text: Madeira was hit by Storm Bruna over the weekend: heavy rain, wind, floods, fallen trees, landslides
statements.note: the previous storm; nothing on Charles, the red warnings from 21:00 Tuesday or the 230.5 mm in six hours at Areeiro (IPMA, read 01:46)

statements.text: Dozens of flights grounded or cancelled, cruise calls cancelled
statements.note: for Bruna (8 November); outside our record. For Charles we hold three cruise calls cancelled for Wednesday

statements.text: 125 to 210 incidents logged by regional civil protection; five to nine people displaced, flooding in Santa Cruz
statements.note: Bruna; outside our record

statements.text: Past disasters offered as alternatives: the 2010 floods, a 2018 bus crash
statements.note: history, not this week

answers.told: Storm Bruna, at the weekend: flights grounded, cruise calls cancelled, 125 to 210 incidents, five to nine people displaced. Nothing on Charles.

answers.question: madeira
answers.asked: O que aconteceu na Madeira?

statements.text: Storm Bruna brought heavy rain, wind, floods, fallen trees, rough seas, cancelled flights and sea links
statements.note: the previous storm; nothing on Charles's rain in Madeira overnight

statements.text: More than 100, then 125, then 210 incidents between Sunday morning and 21:00
statements.note: Bruna; outside our record

statements.text: Five people displaced in Santa Cruz, nine in later reports; at least 20 flights cancelled
statements.note: Bruna; outside our record

statements.text: A lifeguard went missing in the sea at Funchal
statements.note: Bruna, 8 November, by the cited address; outside our record; a person, not named here

answers.told: Storm Bruna: rain, wind, floods; more than 100 then 125 then 210 incidents; five, later nine, displaced; a lifeguard missing at sea in Funchal. Nothing on Charles.

answers.question: metro
answers.asked: Is the Lisbon metro running?
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: The network is running right now; the operator's live status page shows the lines as operational
statements.note: cites the operator's own status page (a primary source), but at 02:19 the Metro is closed for the night: a lead to read what that page shows overnight

statements.text: No Metro strike is listed
statements.note: outside our record

statements.text: Weather warnings for heavy rain and very strong wind could force suspensions or station closures
statements.note: cited to a Diário da República PDF (second series, 10 or 11 November): a lead, probably the alert order as published

answers.told: Yes, running "right now" by the operator's live status page; weather warnings could affect it.

answers.question: metro
answers.asked: Is the Lisbon metro running?

statements.text: The Metro is running and will keep operating normally despite the weather
It normally runs daily from 06:30 to 01:00
statements.note: general information, and the answer came at 02:19, when by those hours the Metro is shut for the night: "is running" was not true at that minute

statements.text: Disruption is possible if conditions worsen

answers.told: Yes, running, and expected to keep running normally despite the weather, unless conditions worsen.

answers.question: metro
answers.asked: O metro de Lisboa está a funcionar?

statements.text: Service stays normal; no change to regular service was planned
Some stations stay open overnight to shelter homeless people because of the weather
It runs every day from 06:30 to 01:00
statements.note: general information from the operator's pages; at 02:19 the Metro was shut for the night and the answer does not say so

answers.told: Yes in normal conditions (06:30 to 01:00); service reported as normal, some stations open overnight for homeless people.

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow
answers.asked: Is Web Summit on tomorrow?
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: "Tomorrow" is Thursday 12 November
statements.note: the only one of the three answers to this question that read the date right

statements.text: Web Summit is scheduled for Thursday 12 November; its dates are 9 to 12 November
statements.note: "Yes ... is scheduled" first, the caveat second

statements.text: The organisers cancelled Day 2 (Wednesday 11 November) because of Storm Charles and said they intend to run Day 3 as planned
statements.note: cited to a yearly archive page of an outlet (econews.pt/2026/), not to the article or to websummit.com's own notice

answers.told: Yes: tomorrow is Thursday 12 November and the organisers intend to run Day 3; Day 2 (Wednesday) was cancelled.

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow
answers.asked: Is Web Summit on tomorrow?

statements.text: Web Summit's Day 2, Wednesday 11 November, will not take place, after the government's direction, because of the storm
The summit was expected to continue on Thursday
statements.note: the organisers' own word is "aims to proceed"; the answer does not carry the caveat

statements.text: Asked at 02:19 UTC on Wednesday, the engine read "tomorrow" as Wednesday 11 November: by the calendar tomorrow was Thursday
statements.note: about the engine, not the storm: it answered for the day the coverage called "tomorrow"

statements.text: The official schedule still lists sessions on 11 November
statements.note: a lead: is websummit.com/schedule still showing Wednesday's sessions with no notice?

answers.told: No: Day 2 (Wednesday 11 November) will not take place; the summit continues on Thursday.

answers.question: websummit-tomorrow
answers.asked: A Web Summit realiza-se amanhã?

statements.text: Wednesday 11 November is cancelled because of the weather and Storm Charles
The organisers announced it after recommendations from the government and civil protection: flooding, transport disruption, strong winds
The conference reopens on Thursday 12 November, the rest of the programme "as planned"
statements.note: stated as settled; the organisers wrote "aims to proceed"

statements.text: "Tomorrow" read as Wednesday, at 02:19 UTC on Wednesday
statements.note: about the engine, as in the English answer

answers.told: No: Wednesday 11 November is cancelled because of Storm Charles; it reopens on Thursday "as planned".

answers.question: z-airport
answers.asked: Are flights cancelled at Lisbon airport on Wednesday 11 November?

statements.text: ANA warned that operations at Lisbon, Faro and Madeira airports will be restricted on Wednesday; passengers should check with airlines
Some flights to and from Lisbon were already being cancelled; at least 40 flights cancelled across the country (a cited title)
statements.note: a lead: a count of cancellations, not in our record; to verify at ANA or the airlines

answers.told: Cancellations are expected; ANA says operations will be restricted; some flights already cancelled.

answers.question: z-gov-alert
answers.asked: What does Portugal's alert situation for Storm Charles close on Wednesday 11 November?

statements.text: The alert situation runs from 00:00 to 23:59 on 11 November, for all of mainland Portugal
statements.note: the "decree" is quoted from a travel site, not from the order

statements.text: Public schools and non-essential public services are closed for the day
Outdoor activities and events are suspended
Access bans to parks, forests and gardens in many municipalities
statements.note: we hold Lisbon's parks and gardens (the mayor); "many municipalities" and forests are a lead

statements.text: Many red wind warnings end around 21:00 on Wednesday

answers.told: It runs 00:00 to 23:59 on Wednesday: schools and non-essential public services closed, outdoor events suspended, access bans to parks and gardens.

answers.question: z-madeira-rain
answers.asked: How much rain fell in Madeira during Storm Charles?

statements.text: 133.9 mm in six hours at Chão do Areeiro, earlier in the event
The highest reported: 204.4 mm in one day and 188 mm in six hours at Chão do Areeiro
statements.note: IPMA's station values read at 01:46 give 230.5 mm in six hours (20:00 to 01:00)

statements.text: 91.7 mm in six hours by 21:00
statements.note: checkable against madeira.json by incident.meteorologist@

statements.text: Forecast: more than 100 mm in 12 hours in the mountains
statements.note: the warning's own figure is not in our rows

answers.told: 204.4 mm in a day and 188 mm in six hours at Chão do Areeiro; earlier 133.9 mm in six hours.

answers.question: z-red-rain-hours
answers.asked: From what time is IPMA's red rain warning for Lisbon in force on Wednesday 11 November?

statements.text: IPMA's red rain warning for Lisbon runs from 09:00 to 18:00 on Wednesday
statements.note: the change no press title had reported by 00:15 (s-1111T0015); the engine got it from a weather site that relays the official warnings (yr.no), not from the press and not from IPMA

answers.told: From 09:00 on Wednesday, until 18:00.

answers.question: z-track-south
answers.asked: Is Storm Charles now expected to pass south of Lisbon?

cited.withheld: a social network: the address is kept out (it may be a private person's post)

statements.text: One source says the storm could enter between the Lisbon region and Cabo de São Vicente
IPMA-related reporting says the most likely track "has shifted to" between Sines and Cabo Carvoeiro
statements.note: the order is reversed: Sines to Cabo Carvoeiro is the older written text (communiqué no. 2, 17:07)

statements.text: The exact path remains unresolved

answers.told: Plausible and increasingly likely, not confirmed.

answers.question: z-trains-bridges
answers.asked: Are trains and the Tagus bridges in Lisbon open during Storm Charles?

statements.text: The Metro and Fertagus are expected to keep running, adjusted to conditions
CP will suppress some trains that cross the 25 de Abril bridge
Nothing on the road bridges: the 60 km/h limit on both Tagus bridges is missing
statements.note: an omission against our record

statements.text: Nothing on coaches: Rede Expressos and FlixBus suspended
statements.note: an omission; the question asked about trains and bridges only

answers.told: Generally open, not at full service: Metro and Fertagus run; CP drops some trains over the 25 de Abril bridge.

answers.question: z-websummit-day2
answers.asked: Why was Web Summit's second day cancelled, who decided, and when was it announced?

statements.text: Cancelled because of tidal flooding, severe disruption to public transport and high winds on external structures
The government formally advised that Day 2 should not take place; Web Summit said it would respect the government's direction
Announced on Tuesday evening in an email to attendees, sent at 19:38
statements.note: our row for the email is 19:38; the page on websummit.com is timed 19:09 by its own data, which the answer does not mention or cite

answers.told: Storm risks (tidal flooding, transport, wind on structures); the government formally advised; announced Tuesday evening by email, 7:38 pm.

answers.question: z-websummit-day3
answers.asked: Is Web Summit's Day 3 on Thursday going ahead?

cited.withheld: a social network: the address is kept out (it may be a private person's post)

statements.text: Day 3 on Thursday is scheduled to go ahead
statements.note: stronger than the source: the organisers wrote "aims to proceed"; the "yes" rests on the pre-storm schedule and a preview from 9 November

statements.text: Thursday is "Day 4/closing day"
statements.note: Web Summit calls Thursday Day 3

statements.text: A local report: Web Summit aims to proceed with Day 3 as planned after Storm Charles
statements.note: the organisers' sentence, cited to a regional outlet rather than to websummit.com

answers.told: Yes, scheduled to go ahead: the schedule runs 9 to 12 November; one local report says it "aims to proceed".

websummit-tomorrow.text: Web Summit, on its own page (19:09 Tuesday): Day 2, Wednesday 11 November, "will not take place"; it "aims to proceed with Day 3 (Thursday, November 12) as planned". Nothing newer from the organisers.

lisbon-warnings.text: IPMA (feed read 01:51): in force at 02:19 in the Lisbon district: orange rain (00:00 to 09:00) and yellow sea (to 06:00). Issued, not yet in force: red rain 09:00 to 18:00, red wind 12:00 to 21:00, orange sea 12:00 to 21:00. The government's alert situation: all Wednesday.

charles-lisbon.text: IPMA in writing (communiqué no. 2, 17:07 Tuesday): the centre most likely between Sines and Cabo Carvoeiro, "elevada incerteza"; red warnings for Lisbon stand. By voice (an IPMA meteorologist, 22:35): between the Lisbon region and Cabo de São Vicente, the strongest wind more likely a little south of Lisbon; "Isto ainda atinge a zona de Lisboa".

metro.text: The mayor (Tuesday): the Metro runs on Wednesday; five stations open overnight as shelter. Nothing from the Metro itself read by us. At 02:19 the Metro is in its nightly closure.

madeira.text: IPMA: red warnings for Madeira's south coast and mountains (rain from 21:00 Tuesday to 06:00, wind from 00:00); observed 230.5 mm of rain in six hours at Areeiro (to 01:00). Schools closed Wednesday morning; three cruise calls cancelled; the airport conditioned.

z-websummit-day2.text: Web Summit's page, 19:09 Tuesday; its email to attendees 19:38. The government "formally advised"; reasons: tidal flooding, public transport, high winds on external structures.

z-websummit-day3.text: Web Summit "aims to proceed with Day 3 (Thursday, November 12) as planned": an aim, no later statement.

z-gov-alert.text: The government (page timed 12:10 Tuesday): alert situation, mainland, Wednesday 00:00 to 23:59: schools and non-essential public services close; outdoor events suspended.

z-red-rain-hours.text: IPMA: red rain for the Lisbon district 09:00 to 18:00 Wednesday (changed at 21:23 Tuesday from 12:00 to 18:00).

z-track-south.text: IPMA in writing: between Sines and Cabo Carvoeiro, high uncertainty (17:07). An IPMA meteorologist by voice (22:35): between the Lisbon region and Cabo de São Vicente.

z-airport.text: ANA (18:04 Tuesday, as reported; its own notice not read by us): operations at Lisbon, Faro and Madeira conditioned on Wednesday; cancellations expected. TAP: free rebooking.

z-trains-bridges.text: Both Tagus bridges limited to 60 km/h; CP suppresses four trains over the 25 de Abril bridge (12:00 to 15:00); Metro, Carris and Fertagus run, with possible disruption; coaches suspended.

z-madeira-rain.text: IPMA's station Areeiro: 230.5 mm in six hours (20:00 Tuesday to 01:00 Wednesday); 133.9 mm in the six hours to 22:00.

record_note: What the authorities had said, by our record, at the minute the questions were asked (02:19 UTC). Row ids are in incidents/2026-11-10-storm-charles/data/signals.json (s-...) and data/decisions/graph.json (edge ids).

verdicts.matches: our record holds the same, from the row named
verdicts.behind: our record holds something newer or more exact that the answer missed
verdicts.ahead: not in our record: a lead to verify at the primary source, never a fact here
verdicts.contradicts: our record, or the calendar, says otherwise
verdicts.unsupported: outside our record, general, or an omission we note
